# Contributing to TourVibe

Thanks for your interest in improving TourVibe.

## Ground rules

- Follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- Follow `AGENTS.md`, `TECHSTACK.md`, `STRUCTURE.md`, and `DESIGN.md`
- Keep the stack on the locked versions in `TECHSTACK.md`
- Do not commit `.env` files or secrets
- Prefer small, focused pull requests

## Local setup

1. Fork and clone the repository
2. Configure `server/.env` and `client/.env` from the `.env.example` files
3. Run the API (`server/`) and client (`client/`) as described in the root `README.md`

## Branch & commits

- Create a feature branch from `master` / `main`
- Use Conventional Commits where possible (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)

## Pull requests

- Fill out the PR template
- Link related issues
- Include screenshots for UI changes when useful

## Security

See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) for private vulnerability reporting.
